items.fullText: 국제 추문에도 정상 출근한 젠슨 황…임직원에 사생활 사과 후 곧바로 '사업 현안' 화제 돌려 발행일 : 2026-11-11 17:18 전자신문을 선호 매체로 추가 공유하기 페이스북 X(트위터) X(트위터) --> 메일 URL 복사 글자크기 설정 가 작게 가 보통 가 크게 젠슨 황 엔비디아 CEO. 사진=로이터 직원들 “나의 길잡이었는데 슬프다” 젠슨 황 엔비디아 최고경영자(CEO)가 혼외 관계를 인정한 뒤에도 평소처럼 출근해 경영 일정을 소화하고 있지만, 회사 내부 분위기는 가라앉은 것으로 전해졌다. 인공지능(AI) 반도체 시장을 이끌어온 황 CEO의 사생활 논란에 직원들이 충격을 받은 데다 중국 정보기관 연루 의혹까지 겹치면서 리더십에 대한 우려도 커지고 있다. 미국 CNBC는 복수의 소식통을 인용해 황 CEO가 엔비디아의 분기 실적 발표를 일주일 앞둔 10일(현지시간) 캘리포니아주 샌타클래라 본사에 출근해 회의를 주재했다고 보도했다. 황 CEO는 전날에도 고위 임원 약 60명이 참석하는 정례 회의를 진행했다. 이 자리에서 자신의 사생활 문제를 언급하며 임직원들에게 사과했지만, 별도의 질문을 받지 않고 곧바로 주요 사업 현안으로 화제를 돌린 것으로 알려졌다. 이사회가 독립 이사 중심의 조사위원회를 구성하고 외부 법률사무소를 선임해 조사에 착수한 상황에서도 황 CEO는 평소와 다름없이 업무를 수행하며 조직의 안정을 유지하려는 모습을 보였다고 소식통들은 전했다. 반면 직원들의 반응은 사뭇 달랐다. CNBC에 따르면 엔비디아 내부 구성원들은 회사 분위기를 '슬프다(sad)'고 표현했다. 오랫동안 근무한 직원들은 황 CEO를 실수가 없는 인물이자 회사의 방향을 제시하는 길잡이로 여겨왔으며, 이번 논란으로 상당수 직원이 충격을 받은 것으로 전해졌다. 황 CEO는 지난 8일 임직원들에게 보낸 이메일에서 아내에게 불충실했던 사실을 인정하고 가족에게 상처를 줬다며 사과했다. 그는 자신의 행동에 변명의 여지가 없다면서 직원들의 신뢰를 다시 얻기를 바란다고 밝혔다. 1993년 엔비디아를 공동 창업한 황 CEO는 약 30년간 회사를 이끌며 인공지능 반도체 시장의 핵심 인물로 자리 잡았다. 특히 고위 임원들에게 직접 보고를 받으며 주요 사업과 경영 전반을 강하게 통제해온 것으로 알려졌다. 그러나 이번 사태는 단순한 사생활 논란을 넘어 경영진의 신뢰와 기업 지배구조 문제로 번지는 양상이다. 상대 여성으로 지목된 앨리스 황이 중국 정보기관의 첩자라는 의혹을 받는 데다 엔비디아 반도체의 중국 우회 공급 의혹까지 제기되면서 기업의 안보 리스크로도 확대되고 있다. 엔비디아가 분기 실적 발표를 앞둔 가운데 시장의 관심은 AI 반도체 사업 성과뿐 아니라 황 CEO를 둘러싼 논란이 조직 내부와 투자심리에 미칠 영향에도 쏠리고 있다. 이상목 기자 mrlsm@etnews.com

items.t: Nvidia’s crisis has corporate governance experts reaching for the popcorn
items.d: The governance experts we talked to say nobody has seen anything like what's unfolding right now.
items.fullText: Nvidia’s stock sank 5.47% on Tuesday, following a 4% drop on Monday, a loss of about 9.5% in two days, even though there wasn’t much news out of the company. CEO Jensen Huang has reportedly been trying to conduct business as usual after admitting to an extramarital affair with Alice Huang, whom U.S. intelligence agencies believe was spying for China. The biggest development: the board hired the law firm Wachtell, Lipton, Rosen & Katz to conduct an internal investigation. What comes next is mostly a guessing game, even for the people who study how boards are supposed to handle crises. Two corporate governance professors, Ann Lipton of the University of Colorado and Todd Henderson of the University of Chicago, say there is no real precedent for a CEO caught up in a suspected honeypot. And while they have views on what the investigation should ask, like everyone else, they’re watching to see how it plays out. “There have actually been affair cases and sexual harassment cases,” Lipton said, but was quick to add that she doesn’t know of previous cases that also involve potential national security compromises. Henderson, whose research interests include corporations, securities regulation, and law and economics, said much depends on facts few people have yet, including, most importantly, what, if anything, Alice Huang got out of Jensen Huang. (Secrets about Nvidia’s fabs or chip designs would matter to the Justice Department. Ordinary corporate information probably would not.) Lipton described the investigation led by Nvidia’s independent board members, with their own outside counsel, as perhaps the most “standard” aspect of the whole affair so far. She also observed that an investigation will be “exactly as thorough” as the directors running it want it to be, which is also standard. items.t: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang’s affair with alleged Chinese spy: a timeline
items.d: The affair could have ramifications for national security as the U.S. and China race to develop the most advanced AI infrastructure.
items.fullText: Nvidia co-founder CEO Jensen Huang has never been as flashy or controversy-prone as AI leaders like OpenAI’s Sam Altman or SpaceXAI’s Elon Musk. Now, the 63-year-old industry kingpin has admitted that he cheated on his wife of 40 years in an affair that could have ramifications beyond Huang’s personal life and potentially impact national security. United States officials believe that Huang’s likely romantic interest, Megaspeed executive Alice Huang, is a Chinese spy who has been feeding information back to Beijing. (Alice Huang, a Chinese citizen, is of no relation to Jensen Huang.) Megaspeed, a Singapore-based AI infrastructure company, had reportedly purchased $4.8 billion in Nvidia chips over the last two years. The U.S. and Singapore have both previously investigated Megaspeed over suspicions that the firm was illegally sharing chips with China. The U.S. and China are embroiled in a fierce technological arms race to build the most advanced AI infrastructure, which could shape each country’s economic future, military prowess, and capacity for innovation. Nvidia is valuable in this competition as one of the world’s largest makers of AI chips, which are essential for accelerating AI development. But as an American company, Nvidia faces government restrictions on the sale of its most powerful chips to Chinese entities. As the controversy unfolds, we are organizing the most relevant events into a reverse-chronological timeline to keep you up to date. November 9, 2026: Huang pulls out of various speaking engagements The Nvidia CEO pulled out of upcoming speaking engagements at the ElevenLabs Summit and Anthropic CEO Forum. November 9-10, 2026: Details emerge about the business relationships between Nvidia and the alleged spy Alice Huang and her family reportedly built a network of companies in China and Singapore to acquire Nvidia chips, including founding a Chinese company called Shanghai Century Litong. items.fullText: NVIDIA Expands Open Source Commitment With OpenShell Donation and New AI Infrastructure At KubeCon, NVIDIA is putting tools to secure agents and run AI on Kubernetes in the hands of the cloud-native community. November 10, 2026 by Warren Barkley 0 Comments Share Share This Article X Facebook LinkedIn Copy link Link copied! Kubernetes, the open source system that manages how applications run across thousands of AI factories, has become the foundation for AI, and the demands on it are only growing. To help meet them, NVIDIA is deepening its commitment to open source at KubeCon + CloudNativeCon , the flagship conference for the Kubernetes and cloud-native communities. NVIDIA is contributing NVIDIA OpenShell , an open source runtime for securing and governing autonomous agents, to the Cloud Native Computing Foundation (CNCF), a nonprofit that is part of the Linux Foundation and the host of KubeCon. As a CNCF Sandbox project, OpenShell will be governed by the organizations building it into their products and strengthened by the expertise of security professionals worldwide. NVIDIA is also contributing to Agent Substrate , an open source Google-led framework for operating long-running agent workloads at scale on Kubernetes that has been accepted into the CNCF Sandbox. Additionally, NVIDIA announced new components of the NVIDIA DSX AI Factory Platform : NVIDIA Kubernetes Engine , NVIDIA Kubernetes Recipes and NVIDIA Snapshot . These tools help teams deploy, manage and scale GPU infrastructure on Kubernetes for AI factories. Together, these advancements mark a step forward in making Kubernetes the leading foundation for AI workloads at scale — empowering developers to build safer, more efficient AI infrastructure for the future. items.fullText: Artificial intelligence Nvidia shares sink while stock market surges The tech giant opened a probe into CEO Jensen Huang’s relationship with a Chinese spy. Listen to this article with a free profile 00:00 00:00 Nvidia announces investigation into CEO over ties to alleged Chinese spy 02:09 Get more news Live on Share Add NBC News to Google Nov. 9, 2026, 10:56 AM EST / Updated Nov. 9, 2026, 4:19 PM EST By Steve Kopack and Rob Wile It was a great day for stocks. Just not Nvidia’s. The company’s shares slid 4.2% on Monday after it announced that it had opened an investigation into CEO Jensen Huang’s relationship with a woman who U.S. intelligence agencies say is a Chinese spy. Despite Nvidia’s importance to the AI trade, the news affected almost no other stocks. The Nasdaq 100, which tracks the top tech stocks at the Nasdaq exchange, soared 3.4%. The broader S&P 500 rose 2.3%. The Dow Jones Industrial Average rose more than 1,100 points. Stocks were also propelled higher by a more than 4% drop in oil prices Monday on news that U.S.--Iran talks were continuing. Nvidia’s peers, such as AMD, Qualcomm, Taiwan Semi and Intel, all rose along with the broader market. Nvidia was the biggest loser on the Dow and the S&P 500. The investigation has the potential to unsettle the entire AI boom, fueled by trillions of dollars of spending and investments, in part to purchase Nvidia’s cutting-edge AI chips. Nvidia’s drop wiped out almost $200 billion in value. Huang, who founded the company more than three decades ago, admitted in a note to employees that he had been unfaithful to his wife. “To my colleagues at NVIDIA, including those I have worked alongside for decades, and to our board, partners, and shareholders around the world: you deserve better from me,” Huang’s email also said. In recent days, the Financial Times and The New York Times reported that Huang had a relationship with a Chinese businesswoman named Alice Huang. items.fullText: Practice Makes Precise: At CoRL, NVIDIA and Partners Reveal How Robots Rehearse Delicate Work in Simulation At the Conference on Robot Learning, NVIDIA is introducing GR00T 2, Isaac Lab 3.0 and new open benchmarks, built in collaboration with partners, bringing precision and scale to robot training. November 9, 2026 by Sasa Docca 0 Comments Share Share This Article X Facebook LinkedIn Copy link Link copied! Simulation, which has long been the proving ground for robots learning to walk, roll and hop, is now helping researchers teach robots tasks that require a finer touch: aligning gears, connecting cables and assembling small components. The shift from locomotion to manipulation is taking center stage at this week’s Conference on Robot Learning (CoRL) in Austin, Texas, alongside the rise of agentic robotics — a new paradigm that integrates frontier agents to create interpretable code for physical robotics systems. At CoRL, NVIDIA is introducing new open robotics technologies, including world action models , simulation tools, benchmarks and agentic workflows. Two NVIDIA papers are among six finalists out of thousands of submissions for the Best Paper Awards at CoRL: GRAIL (Generating Humanoid Loco-Manipulation from World Models), which presents a digital generation pipeline for 3D assets and simulator-ready scenes for robot learning. RoboTTT: Context Scaling for Robot Policies , which introduces a robot model and training recipe that scales visuomotor context three orders of magnitude beyond state-of-the-art policies without growing inference latency. These advancements help researchers train robots on complex tasks, evaluate their performance across changing conditions and use failures to guide further learning — building the precision, adaptability and autonomy needed to move from lab demonstrations to industrial deployment. items.fullText: NVIDIA Announces New Planned Investments in Korean Startups at the MSIT-NVIDIA AI Startup Partnership Forum November 9, 2026 by NVIDIA Writers 0 Comments Share Share This Article X Facebook LinkedIn Copy link Link copied! Korea’s Ministry of Science and ICT and NVIDIA hosted the MSIT -NVIDIA AI Startup Partnership Forum at COEX. Representatives from the Ministry of Science and ICT and NVIDIA met with over 20 Korean startups across foundation models, physical AI, AI infrastructure and AI semiconductors. NVIDIA also announced an investment in Korean startup Point2 , with additional investments planned in Motif Technologies , RLWRLD and Upstage. Point2 Technology, an AI interconnect company, builds scalable, radio frequency-based interconnects that move data between chips and racks in AI factories, offering an innovative alternative to conventional copper and optical interconnect solutions for AI cluster scale-up, delivering the reach, performance and efficiency needed for next-generation AI infrastructure. Motif Technologies , a Seoul-based AI lab, develops foundation models for building AI agents that carry out complex tasks, including Motif-3, a large language model released with open weights. RLWRLD, a physical AI startup based in San Francisco, Seoul and Tokyo, develops robotics foundation models that enable humanoid and industrial robots to perform complex real-world tasks that require five-finger dexterity, such as precisely inserting components, threading nuts onto bolts and kitting parts from moving conveyors. Upstage , a Korean enterprise AI company, develops Solar language models and document AI tools that help businesses extract information from complex documents, streamline workflows and build AI applications for everyday operations. The companies represent work across the full AI stack , from infrastructure to models to robotics applications. items.fullText: Korea Advances Physical AI Across Industries With NVIDIA November 8, 2026 by NVIDIA Writers 0 Comments Share Share This Article X Facebook LinkedIn Copy link Link copied! Tapping into the country’s strengths in manufacturing and engineering, NVIDIA is helping advance Korea’s physical AI ecosystem. The country’s industry leaders are applying accelerated computing, AI and simulation to everything from semiconductor manufacturing to robotics and autonomous vehicles. These efforts are helping bring physical AI from development into real-world production. Samsung Advances Semiconductor Engineering With Accelerated Computing and AI Physics Samsung Electronics is expanding its collaboration with NVIDIA to advance semiconductor innovation through accelerated computing and AI physics. The work spans materials research, process development and device engineering. In technology computer-aided design, Samsung is working with NVIDIA cuISS and NVIDIA cuDSS to accelerate computations involving sparse linear systems. The collaboration also extends to GPU acceleration for process and optical simulations. In materials research, Samsung’s sMOL platform has run selected quantum chemical calculations up to 5x faster end to end with NVIDIA cuEST . Samsung is also exploring NVIDIA cuEquivariance to speed up tensor operations used in training and inference for atomistic AI models. Samsung is developing chip-scale thermal and mechanical analysis workflows with NVIDIA PhysicsNeMo . In one AI homogenization case, combining AI-predicted effective material properties, coarser grids and GPU acceleration resulted in a roughly 1,600x speedup. Simulation time fell from about 18 hours for a fine-grid solve on a 32-core CPU to 41 seconds for a GPU-accelerated coarse-grid solve. Looking ahead, NVIDIA Agent Toolkit could connect these simulation tools and AI models, helping future engineering agents run analyses and compare design options. items.fullText: Korea’s AI Ecosystem Advances and Secures Agentic AI With NVIDIA Hyundai Motor Group and AIM Intelligence explore NVIDIA NemoClaw and OpenShell for secure enterprise agents, and LG AI Research opens API for ‘K-EXAONE-2.5’ trained on Nemotron datasets. November 8, 2026 by Nicola Sessions 0 Comments Share Share This Article X Facebook LinkedIn Copy link Link copied! As AI agents take on more work, they need capable open models and security that advances alongside them. Hyundai Motor Group is exploring NVIDIA NemoClaw blueprints and the NVIDIA OpenShell runtime, while AIM Intelligence is integrating its Starfort platform with NVIDIA OpenShell to support secure AI agents for employee productivity and enterprise workflows . A key component of the NVIDIA Open Agent Safety Platform, OpenShell provides a secure runtime with sandboxed execution and policy-based controls to safeguard sensitive data, manage access to enterprise tools and govern autonomous agent actions. AIM Intelligence , a Korean AI security company, is integrating its Starfort agent control platform with NVIDIA OpenShell. The goal is to combine OpenShell’s runtime access controls with Starfort’s detection of malicious instructions and data leakage. The company is also considering a preliminary proof of concept for the public energy sector, with potential applications across enterprise, industrial and robotics environments. On the model side, LG AI Research is opening application programming interface access for K-EXAONE-2.5, developed using NVIDIA Nemotron datasets, including Nemotron-Personas-Korea . Nemotron-Personas-Korea is an open dataset of 7 million fully synthetic Korean personas, grounded in official Korean statistics, that model builders use to ground training data and evaluation in Korean contexts. NVIDIA Nemotron is a family of open models, datasets and techniques that help developers build specialized, efficient AI agents. items.fullText: From Chips to Skills, NVIDIA and Korea Expand Sovereign AI Collaboration November 8, 2026 by Jesse Clayton 0 Comments Share Share This Article X Facebook LinkedIn Copy link Link copied! NVIDIA and Korea’s Ministry of Science and ICT (MSIT) are expanding their collaboration across the country’s sovereign AI ecosystem, from AI semiconductors and data center infrastructure to talent, startups, models, agents and security. The collaboration lays the groundwork for Korean NPU and XPU companies to explore participation in the NVIDIA NVLink Fusion ecosystem, and includes NVIDIA training and certification programs, hackathons and technical seminars to strengthen GPU utilization. Through Korea’s AI for All initiative, NVIDIA will collaborate with three selected consortia and four leading Korean foundation model builders, using NVIDIA Dynamo software to optimize and scale AI inference. In addition, NVIDIA today announced a collaboration with SK Telecom and Rebellions, supported by MSIT, to advance sovereign AI infrastructure for Korean models and workloads with NVIDIA NVLink Fusion. items.fullText: NVIDIA Dynamo Recipes Bring Korea’s Leading Open Models to Production November 8, 2026 by Amr Elmeleegy 0 Comments Share Share This Article X Facebook LinkedIn Copy link Link copied! NVIDIA is releasing Dynamo-optimized deployment recipes for Korea’s leading open models: A.X K2 from SK Telecom , K-EXAONE 2.0 from LG AI Research , Solar Open 2 from Upstage and Motif-3 from Motif Technologies . As models grow beyond the capacity of a single GPU, they must be split across multiple GPUs, requiring careful coordination of request routing and communication to maintain performance. NVIDIA Dynamo is an open source, distributed inference-serving framework built to deploy models in multi-node environments at data center scale. It handles this routing and communication to maximize inference performance. Optimized for NVIDIA B200 GPUs, these recipes take the guesswork out of deployment, delivering up to 2x performance out of the box. They help developers bring Korea’s open models into production faster and turn them into broadly accessible AI for All services. Learn more about NVIDIA Dynamo . items.t: Nvidia opens investigation after CEO’s affair with alleged Chinese spy
items.d: Huang acknowledged being unfaithful to his wife in an employee memo. The board said it has no reason to believe national security or company secrets were compromised.
items.fullText: Artificial intelligence Nvidia opens investigation after CEO Jensen Huang’s affair with alleged Chinese spy U.S. intelligence agencies determined that Alice Huang, a businesswoman whose company was buying Nvidia’s advanced chips, was a Chinese spy and had a relationship with Jensen Huang, a person familiar with the matter told NBC News. Listen to this article with a free profile 00:00 00:00 Nvidia Announces Investigation Into CEO Over Ties to Chinese Spy 02:09 Get more news Live on Share Add NBC News to Google Nov. 8, 2026, 3:33 PM EST / Updated Nov. 9, 2026, 4:39 PM EST By Steve Kopack and Dan De Luce Nvidia’s board of directors said Sunday that it is opening an independent investigation after CEO Jensen Huang was targeted by a foreign intelligence effort. The announcement followed recent reporting by The New York Times and the Financial Times about Huang’s relationship with Alice Huang, a Chinese businesswoman who the newspapers reported had been recruited to spy for China. The two are not related. A person familiar with the matter told NBC News late Sunday that U.S. intelligence agencies had determined that Alice Huang was a Chinese spy and had a relationship with Nvidia’s Jensen Huang. “The NVIDIA Board is initiating an independent investigation in light of recent reporting that founder and CEO Jensen Huang has been the target of a foreign intelligence effort,” the company said in a statement . “A committee of independent directors, assisted by outside independent counsel, will oversee the investigation. The Board prioritizes U.S. national and economic security, which is paramount to the interests of NVIDIA and its shareholders.” The company added that while it “has no reason to believe that either national security or NVIDIA secrets were compromised, the Board’s inquiry will examine all available information.” In a memo to Nvidia employees that the company shared with NBC News, Huang said: “I was unfaithful to my wife. items.fullText: How NVIDIA Open Source Tools Are Helping Researchers Build Next-Generation 6G Networks With over a million downloads, NVIDIA’s open source 5G/6G tools are equipping research institutions worldwide to develop wireless systems that help robots react faster, improve signal reception and match network capacity to demand. November 6, 2026 by Soma Velayutham 0 Comments Share Share This Article X Facebook LinkedIn Copy link Link copied! Your browser doesn't support HTML5 video. Here is a link to the video instead. A year ago, NVIDIA open sourced its Aerial wireless software , joining Sionna and a broader suite of open source tools for accelerating next-generation 6G network development. Together, they give researchers a foundation for testing ideas, comparing results and building on each other’s work — connecting simulation and AI training with experiments on real over-the-air wireless systems. Today, researchers and developers are using these tools to build 6G-ready networks that do more than just transmit data — receiving signals more effectively, keeping robots and autonomous systems connected when it matters most, and adapting in real time as devices move through the world. Over the past year, global developer adoption of NVIDIA AI Aerial and NVIDIA Sionna software has grown 10x, while NVIDIA’s open source 5G/6G tools have surpassed 1 million downloads. More than 8,000 research and academic institutions worldwide are using these platforms. The projects emerging today offer a view of how future networks could look. Each addresses a different challenge, but together point toward a broader ambition for building AI-native 6G networks that deliver connectivity, computing and sensing over a converged software-defined platform for billions of people, machines and agents. Developers are combining frontier AI models with NVIDIA Omniverse libraries to help carry out that work — building applications for exploring scenarios, investigating failures and improving designs. Developers direct AI agents through natural-language instructions, review results and guide changes. Omniverse libraries provide GPU-accelerated physics, rendering and sensor simulation capabilities. Create Editable 3D Assets With Houdini and AI Agents 🔗 Creating animated 3D content requires connecting modeling, simulation, materials and rendering. Nick Scarcella, a senior technical artist on NVIDIA’s BondLab team, directed AI agents — primarily using Claude — to work with CUDA libraries and Isaac Sim to create animations. The BondLab team uses SideFX Houdini and the NVIDIA ovrtx library to develop materials, lighting and the final rendered appearance. In one experiment, Scarcella guided Astra to recreate an OP-1 portable synthesizer using product images, manuals and technical direction. He exported the model into the OpenUSD framework, tested it in Houdini and Blender, then used Astra and Opus to refine details before adjusting materials and textures for ovrtx rendering. items.fullText: The Wizard of Open Weights: Chris Alexiuk Makes AI Easy With Open Models With a parakeet, a webcam and a conviction that AI belongs to everyone — how one NVIDIAN became NVIDIA Nemotron’s loudest advocate. November 5, 2026 by Matthew Leib 0 Comments Share Share This Article X Facebook LinkedIn Copy link Link copied! Chris Alexiuk has a simple rule about open source AI: If you believe in it, be loud about it. “We should be shouting about this technology from the rooftops,” said Alexiuk, a Toronto-based senior product research engineer in deep learning at NVIDIA who specializes in making open large language models (LLMs) practical for working developers. Alexiuk’s preferred “rooftop” is YouTube , where he’s built a following teaching curious thousands how to build, fine-tune, evaluate and ship production LLM applications and agents. “I think the people who will most help us understand how to build and apply AI likely haven’t even heard of it yet,” he said. “Trying to get knowledge and information out to as many people as humanly possible is what continues to drive me.” Bringing NVIDIA Nemotron to Developers Everywhere Having spent years teaching developers to build with open models, Alexiuk has concluded that transparency isn’t a feature of good AI; it’s the precondition for it. “Fully open source AI is necessary for the democratization of intelligence,” he said. “You should have access to the weights, the data that went into it, the training recipes, everything.” That’s why, on his LinkedIn profile, Alexiuk styles himself “No. 1 Nemotron Fan,” referring to the NVIDIA Nemotron family of open source, multimodal models built for long-running, self-evolving and specialized AI agents. “I think Nemotron is the most important project that exists,” said Alexiuk, who also uses the pseudonym “Joe Nemotron” across social media. “I’m a firm believer that openness is a very important thing to undertake, so I’m going to be the No. 1 fan of whoever is doing that the best.
